say: To land a one-tonne rover on Mars, NASA hung it from a flying rocket.
It was too heavy for airbags,
and rockets firing near the ground would blast dust and rocks everywhere.
So twenty metres up, the descent stage slows to a crawl
and lowers the rover on three nylon cables.
Its wheels drop down to become the landing gear.
Once its wheels touch down, blades slice the cables.
The stage flies away and crashes a safe distance off.
Curiosity and Perseverance both landed this way.
Follow for how the world is really engineered.
